    About

    I am a machine learning engineer at Bloomberg AI, focusing on text generation and argument mining.
    I earned my PhD from Northeastern University in 2021, advised by Lu Wang.
    Download CV

    Previously, I received my B.Eng. in Computer Science from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, supervised by Kenny Q. Zhu.
